summary:
plan.md is written; I checked the block ids with `mcd blocks --check`, but nothing is built or rendered yet. West to east along the open axis (z 58..64): a dark Reflecting Pool (x 20..55) in straight grey coping, then Grant's white platform with a black horseman, lions and end groups.
Next come two green lawns on the mapped heights, cut by a pale central walk and the curving north and south walks. Clumps of dark oaks stand outside the view corridor z 44..80.
Last, a floodlit two-tier white marble terrace (tops y 9 and y 11, x 159..182) with balustrades, urns, fountains and double staircases. It should read by silhouette and colour: dark water, a black horseman on white marble, green ovals, a glowing white terrace. Landscape-only kit: Reflecting Pool, Union Square with the Grant Memorial (white platform, black bronzes), two lawns split by an open central walk with curving Olmsted walks, tree groves, and a two-tier floodlit marble terrace with stairs and fountains. The map's heights are rebuilt column by column. The corridor z44..80 is kept open.

parts.scope: groundColumn over the whole box from the height map (outer 2 cells exact), poolBasin x20..55 z16..109, copingRing x18..57 z14..111, plazaPaving x60..70 z10..114, lawns.

parts.name: Walks
parts.scope: Central walk x71..155 z58..64 with slabStep rises, curvedWalk for the north and south Olmsted arcs, cross walks x70..72 and x150..155, pool walks x16..17 and 58..59.

parts.name: Olmsted terrace
parts.scope: marbleTier for Tier 1 (x159..182, z14..110, top y9) and Tier 2 (x171..182, z30..94, top y11), pilasters, balustradeRun with gaps, urnPier, terraceFlight for central/side double stairs, fountainBasin and grottoNiche.

parts.name: Grant Memorial and statues
parts.scope: memorialPlatform x60..66 z67..89, pedestal x62..64 z77..79 y7..11, bronzeHorseman y12..15, four lionCouchant, cavalryGroup, artilleryGroup, smallStatue for P, g, p and J.

parts.name: Trees and planting
parts.scope: oakTree at every trunk in the plan's Trees table (clip crowns at the corridor z44..80), hedgeBed for the four terrace-foot beds with hidden shroomlights.

parts.name: Lamps and lighting
parts.scope: lampPost every 10 along walks and 12 on pool coping, lanterns under pier coping, glowstone under Grant rim, lamp grid on the lawn edges, light-tool pass so no cell is at light 0.

recruit.why: Rebuilds the height-mapped terrain, lawns, groves and clipped planting beds.
Cuts the pool coping and the Olmsted marble terrace: plinths, pilasters, cornices, balustrades and cheek walls.
Lays the axial and curving walks in half-step slabs.
Builds the monumental double staircases with solid treads and cheeks.
Models the black bronze horseman, lions, cavalry and artillery groups on white marble.
Lamp posts and hidden warm floodlights so no mob spawns and the marble glows at dusk.
